title: Add Figma remote MCP server entry to opencode.json
description:
## Context

## Context

Add the official Figma remote MCP server to the `mcp` section of `opencode.json`. Follow the same pattern as the existing `atlassian` entry.

The entry should be:
```json
"figma": {
  "type": "remote",
  "url": "https://mcp.figma.com/mcp",
  "enabled": true,
  "timeout": 30000
}
```

This goes inside the existing `"mcp": { ... }` block, alongside the `atlassian` entry.

Ref: https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/remote-server-installation/

## Skills

- beads-workflow
- stack-typescript

## Branch

`epic/figma-mcp`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `opencode.json` has a `figma` entry in the `mcp` section with `type: "remote"`, `url: "https://mcp.figma.com/mcp"`, `enabled: true`, `timeout: 30000`
- [ ] Existing config (agents, permissions, commands, atlassian MCP, etc.) is unchanged
- [ ] JSON is valid (no syntax errors)

## Notes

- Do NOT add any API keys or secrets
- The Figma remote server uses OAuth (browser-based auth), no token needed in config
